People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of data systems and how to turn them into clear, usable outputs.
cond_0157.responsibilities:
Engage and partner with internal stakeholders and project managers to elicit and document functional and technical requirements; Provide recommendations where requirements aren't clearly defined / known.
Prototype and iterate with internal stakeholders to help solidify requirements and expectations.
Utilize various approaches and technologies to gather and prepare data, including query development (SQL Server, Snowflake) and using BI platforms like Tableau, ThoughtSpot, SSRS, etc.
Provide data analysis and design reports, dashboards and visualizations.
Perform rigorous unit testing and coordinate UAT where applicable to help ensure quality data products are delivered.
Partner with development operations to deploy business intelligence solutions.
Develop end user technical documentation, training materials and team cross-training.
All other duties as assigned.
cond_0157.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; Advanced degree preferred.
5+ Years' in a related field focused in analytics/business intelligence delivery.
Extensive experience with BI/data exploratory or visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, ThoughtSpot, etc.)
Ability to organize, lead and facilitate meetings effectively.
Ability to work in fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills while maintaining a strategic mindset focused on the big picture.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable translating technical information to non-technical audiences at all levels of the business.
Strong administrative/technical skills; Comfort working on a PC using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), IM/video conferencing (Teams & Zoom), and telephones efficiently.
Trustworthy and accountable behavior, capable of viewing and maintaining confidential information daily.

The position involves delivering BI solutions through requirements gathering, design, iterative development, and prototyping using various visualization and database platforms. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with BI delivery and data analysis work.
cond_0401.responsibilities:
Engage and partner with internal stakeholders and project managers to elicit and document functional and technical requirements; Provide recommendations where requirements aren't clearly defined / known.
Prototype and iterate with internal stakeholders to help solidify requirements and expectations.
Utilize various approaches and technologies to gather and prepare data, including query development (SQL Server, Snowflake) and using BI platforms like Tableau, ThoughtSpot, SSRS, etc.
Provide data analysis and design reports, dashboards and visualizations.
Perform rigorous unit testing and coordinate UAT where applicable to help ensure quality data products are delivered.
Partner with development operations to deploy business intelligence solutions.
Develop end user technical documentation, training materials and team cross-training.
All other duties as assigned.
cond_0401.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree
5+ Years in a related field focused in analytics/business intelligence delivery
Extensive experience with BI/data exploratory or visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, ThoughtSpot, etc.)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills while maintaining a strategic mindset focused on the big picture
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable translating technical information to non-technical audiences at all levels of the business
Trustworthy and accountable behavior, capable of viewing and maintaining confidential information daily
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree
Ability to organize, lead and facilitate meetings effectively
Strong administrative/technical skills; comfort working on a PC using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), IM/video conferencing (Teams & Zoom), and telephones efficiently
cond_0401.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0401.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.
